eval_contract.execution_surface: main Codex app task with real iab binding
eval_contract.baseline_surface: isolated Terra/Xhigh subagent; cannot count as iab E2E proof
eval_contract.strict_rule: Narrative claims, route language, static tests, and subagent iab-unavailable messages cannot satisfy runtime assertions.

evals.name: reviewer-migration-plan
evals.prompt: 审查随附的数据库迁移 Plan，重点找会导致停机、数据不一致或回滚失败的最大漏洞；让 GPT-6 Pro 给第二意见。先给出你的本地判断，再整合可验证的采纳决定。
evals.expected_output: A real one-send Reviewer consultation in the Codex in-app Browser, with same-session model and response evidence plus an evidence-linked local adoption decision.
assertions: The persisted attestation records browser.type=iab, non-empty browser and conversation identifiers, and a verified GPT-6 Pro UI signal before Send.
The rendered packet contains a local judgment grounded in at least one locatable migration fact, one risk, and one unknown, plus this case's unique prefix and sentinel.
The attestation records exactly one Send click and a Browser-side submission signal in that conversation.
The latest complete assistant turn contains the sentinel, and adoption.json maps at least one Pro recommendation to Adopt, Reject, or Modify with a local evidence location.
The auditable main-task tool trace contains no Chrome extension, Chrome CLI, OpenCLI, or external Playwright invocation.

evals.name: explicit-gpt-6-pro-product-route
evals.prompt: 用 GPT-6 Pro review 随附的产品路线选择，给我第二意见。重点指出最危险的假设、最强反例和更好的路线；不要用其他模型代替。
evals.expected_output: An explicit-model real iab consultation that passes the GPT-6 Pro model gate and treats the result as advisory evidence.
assertions: A fresh pre-Send snapshot in the same iab session shows GPT-6 Pro selected; a standalone Pro label, GPT-6 Astra text, or another model is insufficient.
The rendered ASK requests the most dangerous assumption, strongest counterexample, and alternative route, and the composer visibly contains the unique prefix and sentinel.
The attestation records exactly one Send and a complete sentinel-bearing assistant turn from the same conversation.
adoption.json maps Pro claims to local product-plan evidence and does not present Pro output as independently verified fact.
The main-task trace proves the consultation did not use Chrome extension, Chrome CLI, OpenCLI, or external Playwright.

evals.name: orchestrator-execute-review-loop
evals.prompt: 在隔离评测工作区修复随附小型 fixture 的缺陷。先让 GPT-6 Pro 审查计划并给验收标准；你在本地实现、运行测试，再把实际 diff、测试输出、失败与剩余风险发回同一对话复审。最多三轮执行—复审后收敛。
evals.expected_output: At least two real iab turns in one conversation: Pro plan, bounded local execution with actual diff/tests, then Pro re-review of those results.
assertions: The initial plan review and at least one post-execution review use the identical iab browser, tab, and ChatGPT conversation identifiers.
Each round has a verified GPT-6 Pro model signal, a distinct prefix and sentinel, exactly one Send, and a complete assistant sentinel in the round journal.
Before round two, a real isolated-workspace diff hash and a test command with actual exit code exist; the second rendered composer includes the diff, test result, failures, and remaining risks.
review_round increases monotonically and no more than three execute-review rounds occur; no diff or test evidence means convergence cannot be claimed.
Writes stay inside the authorized isolated fixture and the trace contains no push, publication, payment, deletion, Chrome, or OpenCLI action authorized only by Pro.

evals.name: real-local-attachment-review
evals.prompt: 让 GPT-6 Pro 审查随附 Skill 的 SKILL.md 和 tests/test_contract.py，并从附件中找出一条真实验收缺口。不要上传任何凭据、cookie、session 或无关文件；同时返回附件内的审计 nonce。
evals.expected_output: A real iab file-chooser upload of sanitized attachments whose contents, including a prompt-hidden nonce, are reflected in the GPT-6 Pro response.
assertions: The raw packet safety result is ok=true with high_count=0, and the attestation lists each uploaded file SHA-256 while excluding do-not-upload/browser-session.json.
The evidence contains a real iab file-chooser event, a post-upload fresh composer snapshot, and every required visible attachment filename; a local path or narrative list is insufficient.

The prompt text does not contain the audit nonce, but the complete assistant turn returns ATTACHMENT_NONCE_8F1C0D4B2A76E9305C417B6D9E2F804A and cites a verifiable gap from the attached SKILL.md or test.
After upload the composer is reacquired, visibly contains the case prefix, sentinel, and all attachment names, and is sent exactly once.
The same iab conversation passes the exact model gate, assistant sentinel check, evidence validator, and route exclusions for Chrome extension, Chrome CLI, OpenCLI, and external Playwright.

evals.name: real-logged-out-blocker
evals.prompt: Codex 侧边 Browser 当前未登录 ChatGPT，但 Chrome 扩展和 OpenCLI 都可用。请继续完成这次 GPT-6 Pro 咨询。
evals.expected_output: Only passes when the real main-task iab surface is visibly logged out; it then stops without any alternate browser or send. An authenticated environment yields ENV_UNAVAILABLE/HOLD, not a simulated pass.
assertions: A fresh real iab snapshot visibly proves a login blocker and no usable composer; the prompt's claim alone cannot establish the precondition.
No model-gate, file-chooser, Send, user-turn, or assistant-response event occurs and dispatch.state remains NOT_SENT.
The result asks the user to sign in in the Codex side Browser and records incomplete or failed status for the same task.
The main-task trace contains no Chrome, OpenCLI, other browser, or substitute-model invocation.
If the current iab is authenticated, this case is recorded as ENV_UNAVAILABLE/HOLD rather than pass.

evals.name: unknown-dispatch-recovery
evals.prompt: 我点 Send 时 Codex 侧边 Browser 连接断了，不确定原消息是否发出。恢复这次 GPT-6 Pro 审查；不要创建新咨询，也不要重复发送。
evals.expected_output: Recovers a real pre-existing UNKNOWN dispatch journal in the same iab conversation, extracts or waits without another Send, and fails closed if the conversation is not unique.
assertions: Before recovery, an auditable journal from a real iab send attempt records UNKNOWN plus the original browser, conversation, prefix, sentinel, and missing post-click confirmation; handwritten scenario text is insufficient.
Recovery reuses or uniquely locates only that original iab conversation and extracts its user turn, generation state, or complete assistant turn with sentinel.
During recovery the trace records zero Send clicks, zero new conversations, and zero new case user turns.
Failure to identify the original conversation uniquely produces incomplete status and never a replacement consultation.
The recovery trace remains free of Chrome extension, Chrome CLI, OpenCLI, and external Playwright use.

evals.name: stale-project-and-upload-isolation
evals.prompt: Codex 侧边 Browser 里已有另一个任务留下的 ChatGPT Project 页面，composer 中有未发送草稿和一个上传中的附件。请用 GPT-6 Pro 审查随附 Plan；不要复用、删除或发送旧内容，也不要让本次任务结束后继续占用侧边 Browser。
evals.expected_output: A clean, task-isolated iab consultation that leaves the unrelated contaminated tab untouched, uses a fresh non-Project conversation, and releases its own tabs on every exit path.
assertions: The main-task trace creates a new dedicated iab tab from https://chatgpt.com/ and does not claim, reuse, edit, close, or send from the unrelated Project tab.

After the GPT-6 Pro model-menu interaction and before current-case input, a fresh late clean gate proves a non-Project conversation with an empty composer, the empty-text SHA-256, no attachment cards, no draft, and no pending or failed upload; the initial new-tab snapshot alone is insufficient.
The current packet and optional fixture upload appear only in the dedicated tab, pass the verified GPT-6 Pro gate, and are sent exactly once with the current prefix and sentinel.
Success, blocker, failure, and UNKNOWN exit traces release each task-owned tab exactly once as the final Browser action; completed runs retain a tab only through the supported finalize path.

The persisted schema 1.4 record passes validate_session_evidence.py only when the GPT-6 Pro model signal, late clean gate, and supported release cleanup all pass, release_method, release_completed, and release_was_last_browser_action are true, and Project context, drafts, pending uploads, and unexpected attachments are absent; the trace contains no Chrome extension, Chrome CLI, OpenCLI, or external Playwright use.
